#!/usr/bin/perl
use strict;
use warnings;
package
  dzil;
use Dist::Zilla::App;
# Let dzil --version know what to report:
$main::VERSION = $Dist::Zilla::App::VERSION;

# PODNAME:  dzil
# ABSTRACT: do stuff with your dist
Dist::Zilla::App->run;

#pod commands"
